taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Partial loss of drilling fluid returns into formation permeability or minor fractures.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Direct operational match. Standard drilling loss incident.

taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Severe or total loss of drilling fluid circulation to surface.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Direct operational match. Lost circulation is the severe manifestation of mud loss.

taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Mechanical drillstring immobilization during drilling or tripping operations.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Direct operational match. Canonical stuck pipe incident.

taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Immobilization of the drillstring caused by differential overbalance pressure against permeable cake.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Mechanistic subclass of pipe sticking caused by hydro-static pressure overbalance.

taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Annular bridging and accumulation of drilled cuttings around drillstring and BHA.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Direct precursor to mechanical stuck pipe. Cuttings pack-off causes complete string stalling.

taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Uncontrolled influx of formation fluids (gas, oil, water) into the wellbore.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Direct operational match. Well control critical event.

taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Transitional pore-pressure shifts requiring mud density adjustment.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Domain assumption: Historical field responses in NWIS indicate corrective mud weight increases in response to elevated pressure regimes. Limitation: In general geomechanics, pressure changes can also include subnormal depleted zones; mapping specifically to overpressure risk represents an advisory proxy.

taxonomy_mappings.reason_for_mapping: Excessive frictional drag and rotational torque excursions on the rotary drive.
taxonomy_mappings.domain_assumption: Domain assumption: Elevated torque and drag in historical logs corresponds to mechanical torsional resistance spikes. Limitation: Torque and drag includes steady-state drag/tortuosity in addition to acute dynamic torque spikes; mapping represents rotational mechanical risk.

unmapped_event_types.rationale: Broad geomechanical condition (breakout, collapse) spanning multiple operational mechanisms; excluded from narrow 5-hazard classification.
Operational maintenance and hydraulics management process rather than a discrete subsurface hazard.
Mechanical surface/rig tool defect unrelated to subsurface formation-drilling interactions.
Structural casing seat or integrity issue occurring outside active bit-formation interval.
Chemical hydration mechanism; indirectly reflected in wellbore instability and tight hole rather than distinct hazard.
Routine drilling operations baseline with zero non-productive time.
